content:
Meta AI is coming to Threads DMs to offer users a private space to chat with the assistant, without surfacing its replies to the public feed.

Meta AI is coming to Threads DMs after being tested in the public feed

Starting today, users can send a Threads post, image, link, or video to Meta AI and then ask follow-up questions.

This could make the assistant more useful for understanding trending topics, pulling together things shared on Threads, or exploring context that might normally require leaving the app.

The launch builds on Threads's growing messaging features. Meta launched a standalone Threads DMs feature last year, followed by group chats, and has since started bringing DMs to the web.

Meanwhile, Meta AI already lives on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and as a standalone app.

9to5Mac's take

Supporting an AI chat in DMs is more natural and appealing than chatting with bots in the public feed, where it often feels spammy, annoying, and is public regardless. It's a smart move for Threads, which originally launched without even native DMs, relying on Instagram messages instead.
